ideas.title: Following the Money: Uncovering Government Fraud
ideas.description: Investigate government fraud and corruption, following the money trail to uncover the scope and impact of these crimes
questions: What are the most common types of government fraud?
How can we prevent and detect government fraud?
ideas.insight: Government fraud is a serious issue that can have significant consequences for taxpayers and the economy. By following the money trail and investigating these crimes, we can uncover the scope and impact of government fraud and hold those responsible accountable.
